svg.title: assembly-qc-processing: misjoins, the sample's own reads decide
svg.desc: Two contigs whose consecutive alignment blocks land on different reference chromosomes. Left: no read spans the junction and the soft-clips cluster at one position, so the contig is cut exactly there. Right: a third of the reads span the junction, a real rearrangement, kept. A reference-only rule would have cut both.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: an inter-chromosomal junction is cut only where the sample's own reads say the molecules end

svg.text: class J only — two consecutive blocks on different chromosomes, neither in a centromeric satellite. Within-chromosome gaps and inversions are reported, never cut:

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: against one linear reference that is what real variation looks like. depth < 5 → KEEP_LOWDEPTH, review queue — nothing is cut on no evidence. Thresholds are configuration, not code.
